title: Verbs at the Core
label: ch:pt-core-verbs
canDo: I can say I am, I have, I go, I come, I say, I see and I know in Portuguese, pick the right member of its two be-verbs and its two know-verbs, and name the English words each verb left behind.

payoff.summary: The chapter's last lesson closes the set: after saber and conhecer the reader produces all nine first-person forms in one run - sou, estou, tenho, vou, venho, digo, vejo, sei, conheco - and re-derives the roots behind estar and ter.
